title: Screening of peptide inhibitors targeting YAP-TEAD4 interaction: affinity evaluation and anti-AML cell activity.
authors: Yang, Xiaotian; Yang, Shudan; Lin, Guoqiang; Chen, Shutong; Jiang, Huiran; Wang, Yuting; Zhang, Yanming; Zhang, Xingxia
journal: Journal of enzyme inhibition and medicinal chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文通过药效团建模、分子对接和MD模拟筛选靶向YAP-TEAD4互作的肽抑制剂，属于蛋白-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA体系，但分子对接与MD方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合建模，故给予中档评分。
abstract: Aberrant activation of YAP-TEAD4 drives tumorigenesis, progression, and chemoresistance. Disrupting their interaction serves as an alternative anticancer strategy, with peptides better adapting to the large, flat interaction interface. In this study, the peptides 1-4 were screened from the peptide database via pharmacophore modelling, molecular docking, and interaction analysis. Subsequently, affinity experiments showed that among the peptides 1-4, peptide-4 possessed the lowest K(d) values (K(d) = 5.08 +/- 0.42 nM) measured by MST and exhibited the binding affinity for TEAD4. MD simulations further demonstrated that peptide-4 stably bound to the TEAD4. MTT assays showed that peptide-4 suppressed AML-193 cell viability with an IC(50) of 0.65 +/- 0.04 muM. RT-qPCR assays demonstrated that Peptide-4 significantly downregulated the mRNA expression levels of CTGF and CYR61. In conclusion, the data demonstrated that the peptide-4 may serve as a promising candidate to disrupt the YAP-TEAD4 interaction and enhance biological activity in AML-related cellular models.
abstract_zh: YAP-TEAD4的异常激活驱动肿瘤发生、进展和化疗耐药。破坏其相互作用可作为替代性抗癌策略，其中肽类更适合适应大而平坦的相互作用界面。在本研究中，通过药效团建模、分子对接和相互作用分析，从肽数据库中筛选出肽1-4。随后，亲和力实验表明，在肽1-4中，肽-4具有最低的K(d)值（K(d) = 5.08 +/- 0.42 nM），通过MST测量，并表现出对TEAD4的结合亲和力。分子动力学（MD）模拟进一步证明，肽-4稳定结合TEAD4。MTT实验显示，肽-4抑制AML-193细胞活力，IC(50)为0.65 +/- 0.04 muM。RT-qPCR实验表明，肽-4显著下调CTGF和CYR61的mRNA表达水平。总之，数据表明，肽-4可能作为破坏YAP-TEAD4相互作用并在AML相关细胞模型中增强生物活性的有前景候选物。
